name: Slider
description: A single-handle slider component for selecting a single value with filled track, size variants, and optional tooltip/labels
usage: Use for selecting a single value from a continuous range
Use size='sm' for compact sidebar controls in goodies
Use size='md' (default) for standard form inputs
Enable showInput for precise value entry via editable number field
Enable showTooltip for precise value feedback during drag
Enable showMinMax to display range endpoints
Use valueFormatter for non-numeric representations (e.g., percentages, degrees)
Use labelTooltip to provide contextual help for technical or domain-specific parameters
examples:
<Slider
  size="sm"
  label="Angle"
  value={config.angle}
  min={0}
  max={360}
  step={15}
  onChange={(v) => updateConfig({ angle: v })}
  valueFormatter={(v) => `${v}°`}
  showTooltip
/>

<Slider
  label="Commission (%)"
  value={commission}
  min={0}
  max={100}
  onChange={setCommission}
  showTooltip
  showMinMax
  helperText="Choose how much commission each affiliate receives"
/>

<Slider
  size="sm"
  label="Opacity"
  value={opacity}
  min={0}
  max={1}
  step={0.01}
  onChange={setOpacity}
  valueFormatter={(v) => v.toFixed(2)}
  className="mb-0"
/>

<Slider
  size="sm"
  label="Chroma Falloff (β)"
  value={surfaces.chromaFalloff}
  min={0.5}
  max={2}
  step={0.05}
  onChange={(v) => onUpdate({ chromaFalloff: v })}
  labelTooltip="Controls how quickly color saturation decreases as surfaces get lighter or darker. Higher values preserve more color in mid-tones."
  showTooltip
  showMinMax
/>

<Slider
  size="sm"
  label="Angle"
  value={angle}
  min={0}
  max={360}
  step={1}
  onChange={setAngle}
  showInput
/>
design: Filled track uses var(--color-primary) from min to current value
Thumb uses var(--color-primary), ringed 2px in var(--color-surface-card), with subtle shadow (webkit and moz)
Focus ring uses 2px var(--color-border-focus) with offset
Size 'sm' has h-1.5 track, 14px thumb, type-caption-compact labels
Size 'md' has h-2 track, 16px thumb, type-label-sm labels
accessibility: Uses native input[type=range] for keyboard navigation
aria-valuetext provides formatted value for screen readers
Label tooltip uses role='tooltip' and appears on hover of the info icon

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant - 'sm' for compact sidebar controls, 'md' for standard forms

props.name: label
props.description: Optional label text displayed above the slider

props.name: value
props.description: Current slider value (required)

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum value (required)

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum value (required)

props.name: step
props.description: Step increment for value changes

props.name: onChange
props.description: Change handler called when the slider value changes (required)

props.name: showValue
props.description: Whether to show the current value next to the label (ignored when showInput is true)

props.name: showInput
props.description: Show an editable number input beside the slider for precise value entry. Values are clamped to min/max range.

props.name: inputWidth
props.description: Custom width for the input field when showInput is true (e.g., '4rem')

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Function to format the displayed value

props.name: showTooltip
props.description: Show a tooltip bubble with current value on hover/drag

props.name: showMinMax
props.description: Show min/max labels at track endpoints

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text displayed below the slider

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disabled state

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip text shown via info icon next to the label. Use for technical or domain-specific parameters that need explanation.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the container element

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the label element

props.name: valueClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the value display element

props.name: sliderClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes for the slider input element
